claims.statement: Complete factor coverage makes the PFLI excess exactly the count lower tail: coverageExcessSq = lowerTailSq.
Any nonnegative detector equal to one at failures excludes all failures when its total mass is below one.
The exponential occupancy detector excludes zero-source failures when its total mass is below one.
The adaptive occupancy sum is below one on every sufficiently large registered block.
For every K, two 2^K-row panels agree in ordinary and factorial moments through K while only one contains a zero row.
A moment-only one-defect proof requires K>log_2 N and therefore coupled prime-correlation arity 2K=Omega(log X).
No audited asymptotic-sieve, switching, or finite Buchstab framework supplies the required row-uniform post-level parity-breaking hypothesis.
